'''Aurilan''' was a [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] who at one point in history served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]]. Among Aurilan's contributions was the authoring of the book, ''[[Reflections on Form III: Unraveling the Contradictions of Power and Protection]]''. At least one copy was stored within the archives of the [[Jedi sanctuary]] on [[Delriss]], where it survived the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in the abandoned facility.
